We also produce music, art, and have our own in-house media marketing element and ops. **YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** * Create linework of the characters & their props(most of our backgrounds are painted so do not need linework). * Using our concept art as a reference, maintaining designs consistent. * Collaborate with Art Directors * Interpret 3D blockouts of characters & props into more realistic, dynamic & natural poses & compositions. **YOU** * Crucial: Can adapt to the existing style of linework. * Work comfortably in a grounded, historical & realistic fantasy art style * Excel at linework & describing forms through line * Can express character emotion through body language & facial expressions * High attention to detail to maintain consistent designs * Strong grasp of artistic fundamentals, composition, form, anatomy, and perspective being crucial * Transparent and responsive communication * Professional working proficiency in English * Bonus: Versed in cinematic design language & composition or Comic layout & Design **COMPENSATION DETAILS** *Time Investment:* Part-time. Approximately 5-15 hours + 1 feedback call per week (flexible week on week, as we understand you may have other commitments) - you set your own boundaries and communicate your availability. *Salary* : At this point, there is no salary for anyone in our team (from the CEO to the producers to the set runner, nobody draws a salary). We instead give parts of the profit away: *Profit Participation:* We are currently in the development of a profit share/royalty system that will award everyone who is part of the project a piece of the pie without causing any upfront taxation. Upon request for an interview, we will send you a detailed breakdown so you can make a decision on whether or not you want to continue with the application. This is fundamentally an investment contract (time invested, profit participation/royalties gained), and as a result, we are happy to support any due diligence you want to undergo ahead of joining. Thank you very much for considering the collaboration. We hope to see you on the other side and that we grow together on these exciting projects! All the best, Your Soul Atlas Team

title: Civil Engineer T&D
description: **Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Ireland** **Support the delivery of civil infrastructure for renewable energy projects and electricity networks.** Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world. We have been present in Ireland since 1946 and we have a team of more than 950 engineers, consultants, and qualified technical personnel. We work for clients from the public and private sectors, providing creative and sustainable solutions based on the efficient use of resources. Our Energy team in Ireland delivers high‑value technical, design and advisory services across a diverse portfolio of energy and infrastructure projects, supporting the development of a resilient and low‑carbon electricity system. Our work spans electricity transmission and distribution infrastructure, renewable energy integration and grid reinforcement, including civil engineering design to support renewable energy infrastructure, including offshore wind and electricity networks, across Ireland and the wider Arup regions. **The Opportunity** This is an opportunity to join our Energy Infrastructure team and contribute to the delivery of electricity Transmission & Distribution (T&D) projects. The role will involve supporting the civil design and delivery of substations, cable routes and associated infrastructure, providing civil engineering design to support renewable energy infrastructure, including offshore & onshore wind, BESS, Solar and electricity networks. Working as part of multi‑disciplinary project teams from early feasibility and route optioneering through to detailed design and delivery. The successful candidate will work within a well‑established and experienced group, benefiting from strong technical support and exposure to a broad range of civil engineering activities associated with T&D and renewable energy projects. This is a permanent position within the Energy team. **As a Civil Infrastructure Engineer At Arup, You Will** * Deliver elements of civil infrastructure design for electricity transmission and distribution projects. * Contribute to the development of underground cable routing, corridor studies and alignment design. * Support the civil design of substations, including site layout design, earthworks, drainage, access arrangements, hardstandings and structural interfaces. * Support civil engineering design for renewable energy electrical infrastructure, including grid connections and onshore works associated with offshore wind projects. * Understand the appointed design scope, identify associated deliverables and define the workflow required to complete assigned elements of work. * Work within a multi‑disciplinary design team, coordinating with electrical, mechanical, environmental and planning specialists to deliver integrated design solutions. * Produce civil design outputs including drawings, reports, specifications and design calculations. * Support delivery of assigned work packages to agreed programme, quality and budget targets. * Plan and manage assigned workload, ensuring appropriate quality assurance and coordination within the design team. * Ensure all designs are completed in accordance with relevant standards, specifications, safety requirements and client procedures. **Does this role inspire you?** We are looking for a proactive engineer with a strong interest in civil infrastructure delivery within the electricity and renewable energy sectors. **The Ideal Candidate Will Have** * A relevant third‑level Degree (Level 8 or higher) in Civil Engineering (or a related discipline). * Circa 3–5 years’ post‑qualification experience, primarily in civil design, gained within a consultancy or comparable engineering environment. * Membership of a relevant professional body. * Experience in civil infrastructure design, ideally related to electricity transmission and/or distribution, grid connections or comparable linear infrastructure schemes. * Experience working with/interfacing with Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and/or Distribution Network Operators (DNOs), including familiarity with their standards, specifications and approval processes, would be an advantage. * Experience or exposure to underground utilities and cable infrastructure, including trenching, ducting, protection systems and reinstatement. * Experience in site development and layout design, including earthworks, drainage, access roads and hardstandings. * Familiarity with industry software such as Civil 3D, AutoCAD and/or Revit. * Experience working within multi‑disciplinary design teams and coordinated BIM environments. * Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. * Good communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team environment. **How to apply for this vacancy?** To apply for this vacancy, register your updated description: ***Would you like to join our excellent, high-performing team?*** **About Sygna** Sygna is a fully independent, international **leader in commissioning and technical project management** . We specialise in delivering **high-performance building solutions** for **data centres, commercial offices, gigafactories, pharmaceutical laboratories, and historic buildings** . From **project inception and commissioning** to **post-occupancy evaluation** , we **certify building services and technology systems** , ensuring your **design is delivered accurately, efficiently, and reliably** . December 2023 marked a significant milestone with the **EMEA senior management team successfully completing a management buy-out (MBO)** of Sygna (EMEA). Following the MBO, **Sygna is experiencing record-breaking growth** . Under the full ownership of our senior leadership team, we are committed to **expanding our client relationships** , delivering **best-in-class commissioning services** , and driving **innovation in technical project management** across **global markets** . **Why join Sygna?** Are you someone who takes pride in delivering outstanding results, possesses excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and has an exceptional eye for detail? If so, we want YOU to be a part of our team. **Job Description** As a **Commissioning Engineer** , you will play a key role in assisting with the management and delivery of the commissioning process, including leading on-site functional testing. To succeed in this role, it is important that you demonstrate strong communication and people skills, resourcefulness, and the ability to perform effectively under pressure. You will provide hands-on and tactical support for building services commissioning management to the project team throughout the engineering process, from conception to completion, primarily on Mission Critical projects. Our focus is on teamwork, and our philosophy is to be part of the solution, not the problem. We are committed to quality in all aspects of commissioning management, including planning, programming, reporting, collaborative working, witnessing, and smooth handovers to FM teams. **General Duties:** To assist the Sygna Commissioning Managers in their day-to-day activities to include but not limited to witnessing on site testing and commissioning, review of design/testing certification and method statements, input into the project tracking matrix inclusive of AIR, input into commissioning meetings, input into the 2 week lookahead and sub-contractor liaison. Excellent IT, planning, and reporting skills are essential. **Review:** Support the Mission Critical team with reviewing and assisting contractors / sub-contractors in the development of all project-related QA/QC documentation, providing technical input to the formal change control processes. Reviewing the commissioning procedures, commissioning RAMS prior to commissioning activities and commissioning data against design parameters implementing any mitigation of recovery plans. **Record:** Assist with authoring functional/IST test scripts, compiling ‘Close-out’ documentation and final Cx Reports, and creating and managing Handover Commissioning checklists. **Monitoring:** Assist with monitoring and advising when all the commissioning documentation has been reviewed and signed off to the appointed consultants for the project. **Action:** Support with ensuring that all plant/systems have been fully commissioned/inspected in line with the contract specifications, all appropriate commissioning handover documentation has been reviewed prior to handover and comment on O&M manuals produced by the contractor. ■ Key Responsibility: You will attend commissioning meetings. Ensure all parties are co-ordinated for attending witnessing and assist Lead or Commissioning Manager on-site functional testing. **Report:** Attend and report on commissioning and testing as appropriate. Support with issuing the weekly commissioning reports, by providing the relevant information to the lead. **Health & Safety Compliance:** Ensure that you always follow Sygna's Health & Safety systems and local project requirements. Ensure that you maintain relevant health and safety records to meet regulatory standards and company policies. **Governance:** Follow internal Sygna company policies and any project specific requirements **Benefits Include But Are Not Limited To** * Competitive Salaries * Pension contributions * Private healthcare * Regular employee socials * Business travel insurance * 25 days annual leave each calendar year (pro-rated from start date) plus bank holidays. After 5 years of service this will increase to 30 days. * Buy or Sell Annual Leave Scheme * Training and development opportunities * Exclusive discounts on a wide range of products and services, including gift cards from brands like Argos, B&Q, Costa, M&S, and Sainsbury's. * Referral Scheme * Cycle to Work Scheme * Interest Free Travel Loan Our clients trust us to ensure the highest standards are delivered and we are looking for people who have a can-do attitude and share our enthusiasm for exceeding customer expectations. ***If that sounds like you then lets talk.*** If this job is not quite right for you but you like Sygna as much as we do, then reach out to us too; We have ambitious plans, and you may be the perfect fit for the next stage of our adventure. We offer a competitive remuneration package commensurate with qualifications and experience to the right candidate. **Note** The general responsibilities listed herein above are not exhaustive and as such additional duties, which are related to this position in the Company, may be added to the above list at the discretion of the EMEA Managing Director as and when it is deemed necessary. Similarly, as the company grows, there should be an expectation that job roles will be refined over time, to accommodate collaboration with new and existing colleagues. The schedule of delegated authority (SODA) applies to this role and shall always be adhered to without exception. ***We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. The information provided will be treated in strict confidence. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.***

title: Customer Assistant - Charlemont Square (30-35 hours)

But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. These include but aren't limited to: * Competitive Salary * Bonus Scheme\* * Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost. * 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life. * Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.\* * Life Assurance * Pension Plan\* * Save As You Earn Scheme\* * Paid Family Leave * Bike to Work * Long Service Awards * Commuter Scheme * \*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply **About Us** Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity. Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food. We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards. We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/ How can I let Tesco know I need additional support? Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

Make It With Pride.** Reporting directly to Sales Planning Manager, the Customer Development Executive will operate as part of our Sales Revenue Planning team within the Sales organisation; and should deliver on the key business goals of Net Revenue per tonne and Customer Investment. **How You Will Contribute** You will: * Manage the customer deductions for accounts, whilst putting the customer at the heart by developing the relationships to minimise disputes and maximise opportunities to resolve and collect debt. * Business partner sales managers to ensure we work together to manage their accounts’ ledger and debt. Ensure effective communication to improve results. * Be responsible for the timely payment of customer invoices in line with company procedure to ensure that we minimise outstanding deductions on the ledger and post to trade accruals accurately to reflect current liability. * Have regular reviews with commercial and finance teams to ensure trade spend management and timely closure and release of funds through recycling, or recognition of additional liability through manual accruals. * Pricing: Responsible for managing the resolution of pricing claims through collaboration with sales, Customer * Be responsible for managing a clean reconciled ledger for respective accounts. * Be a Point of contact to provide support to key internal contacts, 3rd parties and customers in respect of timely query resolution. * Be responsible for, accurate and complete, record retention in line with company policy. Ensure SOX controls of proof of performance and price change backup are met. Ensure audit evidence exists to support promotional authorisation and invoice payment. * Contribute towards a continuous improvement mind-set to improve process and ways of working. **What You Will Bring** A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge: * Customer Service Mind-set * Excellent Communication skills * Strong attention to detail and organisation skills * Analytical ability * Ability to work on own initiative. **What you need to know about this position:** The CDE should develop key business relationships with their respective Customer Account Managers to ensure that strong links are built to enable better results, while supporting all customers. The Key Business Partners will be Customer Account Managers, Customer Planning Execs and Sales Finance Analysts. **Internal:** The role needs to manage multiple stakeholders in a complex internal structure to build links with various functions. **External:** The FMCG landscape is constantly changing resulting in more demands on our team to handle an increased level of invoicing and price changes. The role has direct contact with external customers. **Job specific requirements:** * Fluent English required. * Administrative experience required. * Good Knowledge of Excel required * Ability to manage multiple stakeholders to build links with various functions * Business Partering experience required * Knowledge of SAP preferred * Knowledge of Categories and Customers preferred. **Travel requirements:** none **Work schedule:** office based/hybrid working The responsibilities of this position are performed within the framework of a regional business model that is defined and managed by Mondelēz Europe GmbH, Switzerland. No Relocation support available **Business Unit Summary** Mondelēz International, Inc. empowers people to snack right in over 150 countries around the world. We are leading the future of snacking with mouth-watering iconic brands such as *Oreo* , *belVita* , *LU* and *Ritz* biscuits; *Cadbury Dairy Milk* , *Green & Blacks* , *Milka* and *Toblerone* chocolate; *Philadelphia* and *Dairylea* cheese; and *Maynards Bassetts* , *Trebor* and *Trident* gums. Our more than 80,000 colleagues around the world are key to the success of our business. Great people and great brands. That’s who we are. Join us on our journey to continue leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. **Job Type** Temporary (Fixed Term) Account Management Sales

title: Development Economist

Your expertise will directly influence the accuracy, depth, and nuance of AI systems tackling some of the world's most complex economic challenges — from inequality and poverty to growth and international policy. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role that lets you contribute meaningfully to cutting-edge AI research on your own schedule. * Organization: Alignerr (Powered by Labelbox) * Type: Hourly Contract * Location: Remote * Commitment: 10–40 hours/week **What You'll Do** * Review and evaluate AI-generated development economics questions, answers, and explanations used in AI training * Assess the quality of economic reasoning related to growth theory, inequality, poverty, and global development * Provide structured, expert feedback to improve factual accuracy and contextual nuance * Apply your real-world or academic experience to validate scenarios and identify gaps in AI understanding * Work independently and asynchronously to complete task-based assignments on your own schedule **Who You Are** * 3+ years of experience teaching, researching, or working in development economics * Strong command of global economic issues, development frameworks, and data interpretation * Able to evaluate written economic reasoning critically and communicate feedback clearly * Comfortable working independently with structured review tasks * No prior AI experience required — your subject matter expertise is what matters **Nice to Have** * Graduate degree in Economics or a related field * Experience in field research, NGOs, or international economic policy * Familiarity with AI content evaluation or annotation workflows **Why Join Us** * Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs shaping the next generation of AI * Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule from anywhere in the world * Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration * Make a real impact by improving how AI reasons about global development and economic inequality * Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: GTM Engineer
description: **About Wayflyer** Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer. Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan. You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney. The challenge RevOps at Wayflyer is a team of builders. We're not just looking for people who can spot what's broken and flag it, that skill matters and we have great people who do it well. We're looking for people who also have the technical range to build the fix themselves, independently, without waiting on someone else's roadmap. We sit at the epicenter of an exceptionally fast-growing business running across multiple channels and partners, and it's our job to make sure the systems underneath that growth have the ability to scale. This role is for a builder who wants to see the impact of their work fast, ideally in seconds, while still thinking several steps ahead so today's quick fix doesn't turn into next year's technical debt. We want people who enjoy the instant feedback loop just as much as the long game. What you'll actually do * Integrations & Technical Ownership: Build, maintain and improve the systems, internal automations and integrations that make our sales and CS teams faster and more effective, from the ground up. * AI-Native Systems: Build, deploy and continuously sharpen AI-native workflows and agents that augment how Sales, CS and the wider Revenue org work, not just automate around the edges. * Data, Analytics & Problem Solving: Use self-sourced data to diagnose what's actually broken, run root cause analysis, and build the fix yourself, then measure it against real KPIs and keep iterating. * Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Ownership: Work directly with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing and Finance to turn half-formed requirements into systems that actually solve the problem. * Revenue Data Hygiene: Own regular audits, deduplication, enrichment and the process fixes that keep our data usable across every system that touches it. * Driving Operational Excellence: Spot inefficiencies before anyone asks you to, prioritise ruthlessly, and build the automated solutions that let the function scale without adding headcount. What this role could turn into This function sits at the intersection of Revenue, Marketing, Finance, Data and Engineering, so you'll get exposure most people spend years angling for. People who do this well tend to move toward GTM strategy, product roles, and beyond. The sky is the limit. Who thrives here You're an AI-native builder who thinks in scale, not one-off fixes, and gets uncomfortable when you spot a manual workaround. You're just as comfortable pairing with Engineering as you are in the room with Sales leadership, translating one for the other without losing anything in the middle. You run towards the hardest, messiest problems, you don't wait for permission, and you don't need a fully-scoped brief before you start. You're always watching what the best GTM teams are building, and you'd rather pitch a bold idea than ship another incremental tweak. We hire for range 3+ years in RevOps, MarOps, consulting or similar, but tenure isn't the point, trajectory is. Whatever your background, you're an AI-native builder with strong business acumen and a sharp eye for the difference between a good customer experience and a bad one. You bring fluency in Python (or Node) and SQL, hands-on experience configuring HubSpot and its developer suite, and comfort with automation platforms like Zapier, Pipedream, n8n or UiPath. You've likely configured CPQ, CLM, sales engagement or customer-success platforms before, and just as importantly, you've driven adoption of something you built, not just shipped it and walked away. Extra credit if you've built and deployed AI agents, integrated AI/LLM-based solutions into existing workflows, or built automated pipelines end to end. Location and working policy **📍** Dublin or London, Hybrid The good stuff 25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity, because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want. *By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at* *privacy@wayflyer.com* *or review our privacy notice at* *https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.*

description: **Job Description** **Why Start Your Career at S&W?** Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Whether that's passing an exam, achieving a personal milestone or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that's invested in your growth, celebrates your successes and supports you to be yourself. You'll learn by doing, working alongside experienced colleagues, contributing to real projects and developing valuable professional skills from the start. As your confidence grows, so will your opportunities, with plenty of support along the way. As a growing accountancy and advisory firm, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. You'll learn from people at every level of the business, gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries and experiences, and develop the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to build a successful career. **The Audit & Assurance Team at S&W** Our Audit & Assurance team works with a diverse range of clients, from entrepreneurial and family-owned businesses to charities, not-for-profit organisations and larger established businesses across a variety of industries. What sets Audit & Assurance at S&W apart is the breadth of experience you'll gain early in your career. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial awareness and a well-rounded understanding of how organisations operate, while working closely with experienced colleagues and gaining exposure to senior leaders and Partners. Together, this provides a strong foundation for a successful career in the profession. **What Will You Be Doing?** As part of our Audit & Assurance team, you'll work alongside colleagues to deliver services to a variety of clients. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment. We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. title: Health & Safety Advisor
description: We are seeking a Health & Safety Advisor to support the Control of Hazardous Energy (COHE) team at a Multi-Fuel Generation Plant (MFGP) in Dublin. As the HSE Advisor you'll provide practical HSE guidance across commissioning, operational and contractor activities, helping teams to plan and complete work safely. Your role will be to focus on applying site requirements for hazardous energy control, isolations, permits and safe systems of work effectively and consistently. **HSE Advice and Assurance** * Advise Global Commissioning Limited personnel, the client and contractors on HSE requirements and safe working practices. * Review risk assessments, method statements, permits and task briefings for commissioning, maintenance and operational activities. * Monitor work involving electrical and mechanical systems, rotating machinery, heat, chemicals and other hazardous energy sources. **Hazardous Energy Control** * Support the implementation and monitoring of COHE, isolation, lock-out/tag-out (LOTO), permit-to-work and safe systems of work. * Confirm that work teams understand isolation boundaries, energy sources, residual-energy risks and equipment hand-back requirements. * Support simultaneous operations (SIMOPS) planning, contractor coordination, emergency arrangements and work-area access controls. **Inspection, Engagement and Improvement** * Conduct site inspections, audits and workforce engagements; document findings, issue reports and follow corrective actions through to closure. * Deliver site inductions, toolbox talks and briefings covering COHE, LOTO, permits and HSE expectations. * Support incident and near-miss reporting, investigations and communication of lessons learned. * Maintain accurate records of inspections, training, incidents and action tracking. * Promote consultation, appropriate stop-work intervention and a positive safety culture across the project. **Role Authority** The Advisor provides HSE guidance and assurance. The position does not, in itself, authorise the holder to act as an electrical or mechanical Authorised Person or Senior Authorised Person, issue permits or control isolations. These activities require formal appointment and demonstrate competence under the site’s authorisation arrangements. **Essential Experience** **Qualifications and Eligibility** * A relevant health and safety qualification, such as the NEBOSH National General Certificate or an equivalent credential. * A valid Irish Safe Pass. * Eligibility to work in Ireland and the ability to meet site-access and training requirements. **Technical Knowledge And Experience** * HSE experience in a high-hazard industrial, power-generation, datacentre, utilities or commissioning environment. * Practical knowledge of risk assessments, method-statement reviews, permit-to-work systems, LOTO and hazardous energy control. * Ability to identify electrical, mechanical, pressure, chemical, thermal and stored-energy hazards. * Working knowledge of Irish health and safety requirements. **Core Capabilities** * Confidence engaging with contractors, supervisors and site teams. * Clear communication, sound judgement and accurate record-keeping skills. **Desirable Experience** * Experience in power-generation plant commissioning, maintenance or operations. * Experience with battery energy storage systems (BESS), HV/MV/LV systems or emissions-control equipment. * Experience of SIMOPS, contractor management and high-risk work planning. * IOSH or IIRSM membership, or progress towards a higher-level HSE qualification. * An update to date first-aid qualification. title: IBM Pre-doctoral Researcher
description: **Introduction** At IBM Research, we are the innovation engine of IBM. Exploring what's next in computing and shaping the technologies the world will rely on tomorrow. From advancing AI and hybrid cloud to pioneering practical quantum computing, we anticipate challenges and unlock new opportunities for clients, partners, and society. Working in Research means joining a team that accelerates discovery at the intersection of high-performance computing, AI, quantum, and cloud. You'l collaborate with leading scientists, engineers, and visionaries to push boundaries and turn ideas into reality. With a culture built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, IBM Research offers the opportunity to grow your career while contributing to breakthroughs that transform industries and change the world. AI systems with embedded large language models (LLMs), like AI Agents, demonstrate significant potential for solving complex tasks by dynamically adapting to feedback and refining their strategies. However, ensuring responsible, safe, and secure deployment is crucial, as these systems face privacy and security risks from malicious actors - be it leakage of confidential information, or injections for adversarial behaviour. This project will focus on systematically analysing threat models, attack surfaces, and exploitation techniques (red-teaming) to identify critical risks in industrial contexts and develop effective defences (blue-teaming). This is key to building trustworthy systems for the future. **Your Role And Responsibilities** This is a fully funded 4-year PhD position at the intersection of AI and Security as part of a new initiative between IBM Research Europe and Trinity College Dublin (TCD). **Benefits** The selected student will be registered at TCD and employed by IBM for the duration of the PhD with the following benefits: Access to resources and expertise at IBM Research and TCD A substantial PhD salary (>40,000 euro per annum) TCD PhD program fees (EU or non-EU level) fully funded **Preferred Education** Master's Degree **Required Technical And Professional Expertise** * A degree in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering or similar. * Basics of Machine Learning and AI: knowledge of ML fundamentals. * Programming skills: Python, version control, ability to write complex code from scratch and extend existing code. * Interest in performing research - including evaluation of existing literature, ideation, authoring research publications. * Ability to move quickly from idea to software prototype for evaluation and demonstration. * Excellent spoken and written English **Preferred Technical And Professional Experience** * Knowledge of GenAI approaches: model architectures, fine-tuning, transfer learning. * Advanced programming skills: Python, data preprocessing (pandas), experience with AI/ML libraries such as Pytorch is beneficial. * Previously published academic papers.

Pay ranges from $50 to $100/hour depending on the projects you qualify into. **Why Apply** * Competitive Pay: $50–$100/hour across the project pool * One Assessment, Ongoing Matches: qualify once, get matched to projects continuously * Flexible Engagement: fully remote and asynchronous, on your own schedule **Responsibilities** * Complete software engineering tasks across a range of AI training and evaluation projects * Review and evaluate code and model outputs for correctness and quality * Deliver clear, well-documented work independently **Required Qualifications** * 2+ years of real-world software engineering experience (full-time or substantive internships count) * Strong fundamentals in at least one major programming language * Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently **Company Description** **AfterQuery** is a research lab investigating the boundaries of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. We're backed by top investors, including Y Combinator and Box Group, and support all leading AI labs.
